title: PaperQA: Retrieval-Augmented Generative Agent for Scientific Research
retrieval_method: Agent-controlled dense retrieval over full-text papers
evaluation_metrics: Accuracy on LitQA; comparison vs expert humans
main_result: Matches expert human researchers on LitQA and exceeds LLM/agent baselines on science QA
key_limitation: Multi-step agent cost/latency; depends on external full-text access
researchnexus_component: Agentic RAG QA; citation grounding

title: Language agents achieve superhuman synthesis of scientific knowledge
primary_problem_domain: Scientific literature synthesis / QA / contradiction detection
retrieval_method: Top-k dense retrieval then LLM re-ranking and contextual chunk summarisation
agentic_level: Agentic tool-use (retrieval / rerank / summarise / answer); ContraCrow contradiction agent
evaluation_metrics: Accuracy vs PhD/postdoc experts; citation accuracy; contradictions per paper
main_result: Matches or exceeds subject-matter experts on literature retrieval tasks; ~2.34 contradictions/paper (70% human-validated)
key_limitation: Preprint; heavy API cost; biology-centric evaluation
researchnexus_component: Agentic RAG; multi-paper synthesis; research-gap (contradictions); citation grounding

title: Synthesizing scientific literature with retrieval-augmented language models (OpenScholar)
retrieval_method: Retrieval over 45M open-access papers; passage index; iterative self-feedback retrieval
dataset: ScholarQABench (2967 expert queries; 208 long-form answers; CS/physics/neuro/biomed)
main_result: OpenScholar-8B beats GPT-4o by ~5% and PaperQA2 by ~7% on correctness; citation accuracy on par with human experts vs GPT-4o hallucinating 78-90%
key_limitation: 8B model still trails largest proprietary models on some axes; datastore build cost
researchnexus_component: Scientific RAG; citation grounding; multi-paper synthesis; evaluation

title: Ai2 Scholar QA: Organized Literature Synthesis with Attribution
retrieval_method: Hybrid BM25 + dense over ~8M full-text papers on Vespa; transformer reranker; top-50 kept
agentic_level: RAG pipeline with 3-step generation (quote extraction / outline+clustering / section-wise report); table generation is schema+value
evaluation_metrics: Correctness vs competing systems; table quality
main_result: Outperforms competing scientific QA systems on a recent benchmark; produces per-subtopic comparison tables with attribution
key_limitation: Closed LLM; corpus limited to indexed open-access; table eval preliminary
researchnexus_component: Multi-paper QA; comparison tables; citation/attribution; outline

title: PaperHelper: Knowledge-Based LLM QA Paper Reading Assistant
retrieval_method: RAG with RAG-Fusion (multi-query) retrieval; RAFT-style fine-tuning
agentic_level: RAG app (fine-tuned) with search / gather-evidence / answer tools
dataset: 52k ML-domain papers for RAFT fine-tuning; QA eval set
main_result: F1 60.04 at 5.8 s latency; ~7% F1 over basic RAG
key_limitation: Preprint; ML-domain fine-tuning only; F1 still modest
researchnexus_component: Single-paper RAG QA; hallucination reduction

title: Hallucination-Resistant Domain-Specific Research Assistant with Self-Evaluation and Vector-Grounded Retrieval
retrieval_method: Vector retrieval + relational metric store; retrieval only when self-eval says needed
agentic_level: Agentic finite-state loop (Relevance -> Confidence -> Knowledge); self-evaluation; deterministic citation pipeline; I-dont-know fallback
evaluation_metrics: Blinded expert A/B preference; citation-fidelity (fabrication / DOI-match / claim coverage); ECE/AURC
main_result: Experts prefer RA-FSM over Notebook LM and vanilla GPT; fabricated references near-zero
key_limitation: Preprint; single narrow domain; added latency/cost
researchnexus_component: Agentic verification; self-evaluation; deterministic citation; evidence grounding

title: PaSa: An LLM Agent for Comprehensive Academic Paper Search
primary_problem_domain: Agentic academic paper search / related-paper discovery
retrieval_method: Two-agent Crawler (search-tool calls + citation expansion + stop) and Selector; RL-optimised
agentic_level: Agentic multi-agent (Crawler + Selector) with iterative multi-hop search and citation-graph expansion
main_result: PaSa-7B +37.78% recall@20 and +39.90% recall@50 vs Google+GPT-4o; beats PaSa-GPT-4o
key_limitation: Trained on synthetic queries; AI-conference domain bias; no downstream synthesis
researchnexus_component: Seed-paper -> related-paper discovery; agentic search; multi-hop; citation graph

title: LitLLM: A Toolkit for Scientific Literature Review
primary_problem_domain: Related-work generation from a seed abstract
retrieval_method: LLM keyword summarisation of the seed abstract -> external search -> abstract-conditioned re-ranking
agentic_level: RAG app with plan-then-generate; not autonomous
main_result: RAG + reranking + plan-then-generate substantially reduce review effort vs plain LLM
key_limitation: No autonomous search; hallucination still possible; limited quantitative eval
researchnexus_component: Search-concept generation; seed -> related; related-work synthesis

title: LitLLMs LLMs for Literature Review: Are we there yet?
retrieval_method: Two-step: LLM keyword extraction from seed abstract -> external knowledge-base query -> LLM re-ranking
agentic_level: RAG app with plan-then-generate; not autonomous
dataset: arXiv-derived eval set with contamination controls
main_result: Re-ranking doubles normalized recall vs naive search; plan-then-generate improves reviews
key_limitation: Zero-shot only; retrieval bounded by external KB; no multi-hop
researchnexus_component: Seed abstract -> related-paper retrieval + ranking; review synthesis

title: LitSearch: A Retrieval Benchmark for Scientific Literature Search
retrieval_method: BM25 vs dense retrievers; LLM reranking
dataset: LitSearch (597 queries over recent ML/NLP papers)
main_result: Dense retrievers beat BM25 by 24.8 absolute Recall@5; LLM rerank +4.4%; Google Search 32 pts behind best dense retriever
key_limitation: Domain limited to recent ML/NLP; 597 queries; no full-text reasoning eval
researchnexus_component: Retrieval quality benchmark for RN academic search + related-paper discovery

title: SciRepEval: A Multi-Format Benchmark for Scientific Document Representations
primary_problem_domain: Scientific document representation for search / recommendation / classification
retrieval_method: Embedding similarity + ad-hoc search task format
dataset: SciRepEval (24 tasks; 4 formats: classification / regression / ranking / search)
main_result: Task-format adapters beat single-embedding SOTA by >2 points absolute
key_limitation: Encoder must be re-run per task format; English scientific text
researchnexus_component: Embedding-based related-paper similarity; recommendation; retrieval baseline

title: ResearchAgent: Iterative Research Idea Generation over Scientific Literature with LLMs
primary_problem_domain: Research-idea and future-direction generation from a seed paper
retrieval_method: Core paper -> citation/academic-graph neighbours + entity-centric knowledge store retrieval
agentic_level: Agentic multi-agent (generator + multiple ReviewingAgents; iterative revision)
main_result: Generates ideas rated novel/clear/valid; iterative peer-review-style refinement improves them
key_limitation: No experiment execution; idea validity unverified; graph coverage bias
researchnexus_component: Seed paper -> research profile -> research trail -> research directions

title: Academic literature recommendation in large-scale citation networks enhanced by large language models
retrieval_method: Hybrid: network-based citation proximity + content-based semantic similarity
llm_used: LLM used for semantic enhancement only
main_result: Hybrid citation + LLM-embedding recommendation outperforms network-only and content-only baselines
key_limitation: Cold-start for brand-new papers; embedding-model API dependency
researchnexus_component: Citation-graph related-paper discovery; ranking; recommendation

title: ArxivDIGESTables: Synthesizing Scientific Literature into Tables using Language Models
retrieval_method: In-text references + table caption as grounding context
evaluation_metrics: DecontextEval (aspect alignment); recall of reference-table columns/values
main_result: LLMs partially reconstruct expert tables; caption/in-text grounding helps; novel aspects still useful
key_limitation: Full table reconstruction remains hard; hallucinated cell values
researchnexus_component: Multi-paper comparison; method/result comparison; research trail

title: CHIME: LLM-Assisted Hierarchical Organization of Scientific Studies for Literature Review Support
primary_problem_domain: Hierarchical organisation of study sets for review
retrieval_method: Study set assumed given; LLM builds category tree and assigns studies
evaluation_metrics: F1 on category links and study assignment
main_result: LLMs good at generating categories; corrector trained on human feedback improves study assignment by +12.6 F1
key_limitation: Requires curated study set as input; assignment errors without correction
researchnexus_component: Research-trail structuring; multi-paper organisation

title: AutoSurvey: Large Language Models Can Automatically Write Surveys
retrieval_method: Initial retrieval -> outline -> parallel subsection drafting -> integration/refinement
agentic_level: Multi-LLM parallel drafting pipeline (not autonomous agents)
llm_used: Multiple LLMs concurrently (specifics not verified here)
dataset: AI/ML survey topics; own evaluation protocol
evaluation_metrics: Citation recall / precision; content coverage / structure / relevance (LLM + expert)
main_result: 8k-token survey: citation recall 82.48 / precision 77.42 vs naive RAG 78.14 / 71.92; content quality near human
key_limitation: Long-context limits; parametric-knowledge staleness; automatic eval bias
researchnexus_component: Multi-paper synthesis; outline generation; citation grounding

title: SurveyForge: Outline Heuristics Memory-Driven Generation and Multi-dimensional Evaluation for Automated Survey Writing
primary_problem_domain: Automated survey writing with better outlines/citations
retrieval_method: Memory-driven Scholar Navigation Agent (SANA) retrieves per subsection
agentic_level: Agentic (SANA retrieval agent) + heuristic outline learning
main_result: Outperforms AutoSurvey on outline quality and citation accuracy
key_limitation: Still trails human surveys; evaluation partly LLM-based
researchnexus_component: Outline heuristics; per-section retrieval; multi-paper synthesis

title: Assisting in Writing Wikipedia-like Articles From Scratch with Large Language Models
primary_problem_domain: Grounded long-form article writing from scratch
retrieval_method: Multi-perspective simulated QA -> internet search -> outline curation
evaluation_metrics: Outline coverage/organization vs outline-driven RAG baseline; expert feedback
main_result: +25% organized and +10% broad-coverage over RAG baseline; identifies source-bias transfer + over-association
key_limitation: Not scientific-domain-specific; factuality gaps remain
researchnexus_component: Search-concept generation; outline; grounded synthesis

title: ChatCite: LLM Agent with Human Workflow Guidance for Comparative Literature Summary
retrieval_method: Key-Element Extractor over relevant literature; Reflective Incremental Generator
evaluation_metrics: G-Score (LLM metric aligned to human criteria); ROUGE
main_result: Outperforms vanilla CoT and prior summarisers on comparative-summary dimensions
key_limitation: Depends on quality of provided literature set; limited human eval
researchnexus_component: Multi-paper comparison; cross-paper synthesis

title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
retrieval_method: LLM entity-relation graph -> community detection -> community summaries -> map-reduce global answer
evaluation_metrics: LLM head-to-head win-rate on comprehensiveness / diversity / empowerment
main_result: Substantial win-rate gains over vector RAG on global questions; root-level community summaries competitive at a fraction of token cost
key_limitation: Graph build cost; preprint; not scientific-paper-specific
researchnexus_component: Corpus-level research-gap and theme synthesis; multi-paper reasoning

title: PDFTriage: Question Answering over Long Structured Documents
retrieval_method: LLM triage selects document frame by structure or content (sections / tables / figures)
dataset: 900+ questions over 80 structured documents; 10 question categories
evaluation_metrics: Human preference vs plain retrieval-augmented LLM
main_result: Better on structure questions and table reasoning; weaker on simple text/classification questions
key_limitation: GPT-3.5 triage errors; needs reliable structure extraction
researchnexus_component: Structure-aware PDF processing; section/table retrieval

title: M3SciQA: A Multi-Modal Multi-Document Scientific QA Benchmark
retrieval_method: Anchor-paper locality question -> retrieve reference paper -> multi-doc detailed QA
llm_used: 18 foundation models incl. GPT-4o / GPT-4V / open MLLMs
dataset: M3SciQA (1452 expert questions; 70 NLP paper clusters incl. cited docs)
evaluation_metrics: MRR (anchor retrieval); accuracy (detailed QA); human comparison
main_result: Best models far below human experts on cross-document + figure/table reasoning
key_limitation: NLP-domain clusters only; static benchmark
researchnexus_component: Multi-paper QA; multi-hop discovery; figure/table limits

title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
retrieval_method: Retrieve from corpus then generate with inline citations
main_result: Best systems lack complete citation support ~50% of the time (ELI5); large headroom
key_limitation: Automatic citation NLI is imperfect; English only
researchnexus_component: Citation grounding + citation-quality metrics for RN answers

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve Generate and Critique through Self-Reflection

agentic_level: Agentic self-reflection (reflection tokens: retrieve? relevant? supported? useful?)
dataset: Open-domain QA; reasoning; fact verification; long-form generation (ASQA/bio)
main_result: Outperforms ChatGPT and retrieval-augmented Llama2-chat; large gains in citation accuracy for long-form
key_limitation: Needs training with reflection tokens; retriever-quality bound
researchnexus_component: Agentic verification; adaptive retrieval; citation accuracy
